generationInputs.prompt: The scene opens with a static full shot, showcasing two distinct scenarios side-by-side against a plain white background. On the left, a fair-skinned adult female with shoulder-length hair, one half blonde and the other dark brown, stands facing the viewer. She is dressed in a short-sleeved blue and black dress with a white collar and holds a square orange crate filled with vibrantly colored fruits and vegetables. The crate has a yellow interior and she grips its bottom edge with both hands. To the right, a fair-skinned adult female with dark hair pulled back in a low ponytail is riding a red bicycle. She is seen in profile, facing left, with her feet on the pedals and hands on the handlebars. She wears a yellow long-sleeved shirt over a red sleeveless top, blue pants, and red shoes. A matching orange crate filled with similar produce is attached to the rear rack of the bicycle.
